# Bundled browser libraries

- sockjs.min.js: sockjs-client 1.6.1, downloaded from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/sockjs-client/1.6.1/sockjs.min.js. MIT license in SOCKJS-LICENSE.txt. Upstream: https://github.com/sockjs/sockjs-client.
- stomp.min.js: stomp.js 2.3.3, downloaded from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/stomp.js/2.3.3/stomp.min.js. Apache 2.0 license in STOMP-LICENSE.txt; copyright notices retained in JavaScript header. Upstream: https://github.com/jmesnil/stomp-websocket.

Files are unmodified upstream distributions. Bundling removes runtime CDN dependence.
